links.outcome: Surgical duration prediction error (MAE, R^2) with retrieval-grounded prompts versus zero-shot LLM inference
links.effect: Reduced MAE by up to 40% and raised R^2 from -0.13 to 0.62 over zero-shot inference; accuracy competitive with supervised ML methods.
links.quote: PREBA significantly improves performance-for instance, reducing MAE by up to 40% and raising R^2 from -0.13 to 0.62 over zero-shot inference-and it achieves accuracy competitive with supervised ML methods, demonstrating strong effectiveness and generalization.

unlisted_practices: PCA-weighted retrieval of similar historical cases combined with Bayesian averaging of multi-round LLM predictions with population-level statistical priors to stabilize predictions

screen.reason: Evaluates adding retrieval-augmented clinical context (similar historical cases and statistical priors) to off-the-shelf LLMs to ground zero-shot predictions for surgical duration estimation.

primary.practice: retrieval-augmented grounding with local historical cases and statistical priors
